'''Koyi Kobad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[permitor]] working in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]]. She was affiliated to the [[House Pthen]] and specialized in guiding customers to luxury business and getting them permits to enjoy their stay in Depatar.

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Kobad approached a landing ship, hoping that the visitors would hire her to assist with their permits. Other prospectives included [[Furran]], [[Gusimin]] the Honest, [[Maltok]] and [[Sadana]]. All of them were disappointed to discover that they had already hired [[Fot Ducela]].
